t.en: Orthogonally diagonalize a real symmetric matrix.
t.zh: 把实对称矩阵正交对角化。

t.en: In Chapter “Eigenvalues”, we saw that some matrices are diagonalizable, and others are not. In this section, we will see that the theory of diagonalization is much nicer when the matrix to be diagonalized is symmetric. Recall that a matrix $A$ is **symmetric** if $A=A^T$. We begin with some observations about the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a real symmetric matrix.
t.zh: 在“特征值”一章中，我们看到有些矩阵可对角化，另一些则不能。这一节我们将看到，当待对角化的矩阵是对称矩阵时，对角化的理论要漂亮得多。回想一下，如果 $A=A^T$，矩阵 $A$ 就称为**对称的**（symmetric）。我们先来观察实对称矩阵的特征值和特征向量。

title.en: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of real symmetric matrices
title.zh: 实对称矩阵的特征值与特征向量

t.zh: $A$ 的属于不同特征值的特征向量是正交的。

t.en: Recall that an $n\times n$-matrix $A$ is **diagonalizable** if there exists an invertible matrix $P$ and a diagonal matrix $D$ such that $D = P^{-1}AP$. We say that $A$ is **orthogonally diagonalizable** if $P$ can, moreover, be chosen to be orthogonal. Orthogonal diagonalizability is a convenient property, because when $P$ is orthogonal, then $P^{-1}=P^T$, and we can interchangeably write $D = P^{-1}AP$ or $D = P^TAP$. The following is the main theorem about the diagonalization of real symmetric matrices.
t.zh: 回想一下，如果存在可逆矩阵 $P$ 和对角矩阵 $D$ 使得 $D = P^{-1}AP$，则称 $n\times n$ 矩阵 $A$ **可对角化**（diagonalizable）。如果 $P$ 还可以取成正交矩阵，就说 $A$ **可正交对角化**（orthogonally diagonalizable）。可正交对角化是一个很方便的性质：当 $P$ 是正交矩阵时，$P^{-1}=P^T$，于是 $D = P^{-1}AP$ 与 $D = P^TAP$ 可以互换着写。下面是关于实对称矩阵对角化的主要定理。

t.en: Every real symmetric matrix $A$ is orthogonally diagonalizable.
t.zh: 每个实对称矩阵 $A$ 都可正交对角化。

t.en: By induction on the size of the matrix. For a $1\times 1$-matrix, there is nothing to show, as it is already diagonal. Now consider a real symmetric $n\times n$-matrix $A$ with $n\geq 2$. By the fundamental theorem of algebra, the characteristic polynomial has at least one root, so that $A$ has at least one (possibly complex) eigenvalue $\eigenvar$. By Proposition “Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of real symmetric matrices”(a), $\eigenvar$ is real. Since we can solve the system of equations $(A-\eigenvar I)\vect{v}=\vect{0}$ over the real numbers, there exists a real eigenvector $\vect{v}$ for the eigenvalue $\eigenvar$. We can assume without loss of generality that $\vect{v}$ is normalized, because else we could replace $\vect{v}$ by $\frac{1}{\norm{\vect{v}}}\vect{v}$. By the Gram-Schmidt method, we can find an orthonormal basis $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_n}$ of $\R^n$ such that $\vect{u}_1=\vect{v}$. Let $Q$ be the orthogonal matrix that has $\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_n$ as its columns, and consider $B=Q^{-1}AQ$. Since $B\vect{e}_1 = Q^{-1}AQ\vect{e}_1 = Q^{-1}A\vect{u}_1 = \eigenvar Q^{-1}\vect{u}_1 = \eigenvar\vect{e}_1$, the matrix $B$ is of the form
t.zh: 对矩阵的阶数用归纳法。对于 $1\times 1$ 矩阵，没有什么需要证明的，因为它本身已经是对角矩阵。现在考虑 $n\geq 2$ 的实对称 $n\times n$ 矩阵 $A$。由代数基本定理，特征多项式至少有一个根，所以 $A$ 至少有一个（可能是复数的）特征值 $\eigenvar$。由命题“实对称矩阵的特征值与特征向量”(a)，$\eigenvar$ 是实数。因为我们可以在实数范围内解方程组 $(A-\eigenvar I)\vect{v}=\vect{0}$，所以存在属于特征值 $\eigenvar$ 的实特征向量 $\vect{v}$。我们可以不妨设 $\vect{v}$ 是单位向量，因为否则可以把 $\vect{v}$ 换成 $\frac{1}{\norm{\vect{v}}}\vect{v}$。由施密特正交化方法，可以找到 $\R^n$ 的一个标准正交基 $\set{\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_n}$，使得 $\vect{u}_1=\vect{v}$。设 $Q$ 是以 $\vect{u}_1,\ldots,\vect{u}_n$ 为各列的正交矩阵，并考虑 $B=Q^{-1}AQ$。因为 $B\vect{e}_1 = Q^{-1}AQ\vect{e}_1 = Q^{-1}A\vect{u}_1 = \eigenvar Q^{-1}\vect{u}_1 = \eigenvar\vect{e}_1$，所以矩阵 $B$ 具有如下形式

t.en: Prove the converse of Theorem “Diagonalization of real symmetric matrices”: if a matrix $A$ is orthogonally diagonalizable, then $A$ is symmetric.
t.zh: 证明定理“实对称矩阵的对角化”的逆命题：如果矩阵 $A$ 可正交对角化，则 $A$ 是对称的。

t.en: Suppose $A$ is orthogonally diagonalizable. Then $A=PDP^{-1}$, where $D$ is diagonal and $P$ is orthogonal. Since $P$ is orthogonal, we have $P^{-1}=P^T$, and therefore $A=PDP^T$. Moreover, since $D$ is diagonal, we have $D=D^T$. It follows that $A^T = (PDP^T)^T = (P^T)^T D^T P^T = PDP^T = A$, so $A$ is symmetric.
t.zh: 设 $A$ 可正交对角化。则 $A=PDP^{-1}$，其中 $D$ 是对角矩阵，$P$ 是正交矩阵。因为 $P$ 是正交矩阵，所以 $P^{-1}=P^T$，从而 $A=PDP^T$。又因为 $D$ 是对角矩阵，所以 $D=D^T$。由此得 $A^T = (PDP^T)^T = (P^T)^T D^T P^T = PDP^T = A$，所以 $A$ 是对称的。
